infinity.extra.time.climate.blizzard.des: Whiteout snow, wind gusts that push, slow freezing; snow and ice on the edge.
infinity.extra.time.climate.ash.desc: Falling ash and embers under an orange sky; embers ignite anyone without a helmet and small safe fires start on the ground.
infinity.extra.time.climate.cherry.desc: A storm of petals and soft pink light; Regeneration I inside and plants grow.
infinity.extra.time.climate.supercell.de: A rotating wall cloud and frequent lightning inside the zone only; a swirling wind pushes enemies around.
infinity.extra.time.climate.meteor.desc: A night sky with shooting stars and sparkles that land; night vision inside and hostile mobs glow.
infinity.extra.time.climate.toxic.desc: Green acid fog; poison for enemies and monsters inside the area.
infinity.extra.time.climate.starfall.des: A forced night sky with aurora and slow falling stars; night vision, slow falling and higher jumps.
infinity.extra.time.climate.heat.desc: Shimmering air, a huge sun and evaporating water; crops grow fast and enemies get hungry.
infinity.extra.time.climate.rainbow.desc: A drizzle that clears and leaves a giant rainbow in the sky; luck for everyone inside.
Mind + Reality conjunction. Left: on / off. While on, a golden ghost of the brush follows the surface you look at. Left: build the shape (blocks of light grow outward from the point); Right: shape menu (block, line from the last point, wall, floor, stairs, bridge to the aim, dome shelter); Scroll: size; Sneak+Left: undo the last one; middle click: stop. It only fills free air, never inside players or creatures. Up to 512 blocks, they drop nothing and fade with a shimmer after 2 min.
infinity.wheel.dual.lucid_dream: Left: on / off  ·  Right: shape menu
infinity.extra.v2d.lucid.brush.single.de: A block of light (or a cube, by size) where you aim.
infinity.extra.v2d.lucid.brush.line.desc: A line from the last built point to your aim.
infinity.extra.v2d.lucid.brush.wall.desc: A wall facing you, wider and taller with the size.
infinity.extra.v2d.lucid.brush.floor.des: A flat square platform at the height of your aim.
infinity.extra.v2d.lucid.brush.stairs.de: Stairs climbing in the direction you look.
infinity.extra.v2d.lucid.brush.bridge.de: A bridge at foot level out to the aimed point.
infinity.extra.v2d.lucid.brush.dome.desc: A dome shelter around the aimed point, with a door facing you.
infinity.extra.v2d.lucid.hud_keys: Left: build · Right: shapes · Scroll: size · Sneak+Left: undo · Middle: stop
infinity.extra.area_heist.tool.deploy.de: Right click: re-anchor the ghost where you aim.
infinity.extra.area_heist.tool.move.desc: Ctrl+scroll: move 1 block along your look direction.
infinity.extra.area_heist.tool.move_y.de: Ctrl+scroll: up or down by 1 block.
infinity.extra.area_heist.tool.print.des: Right click: paste the structure here.
infinity.extra.area_heist.tool.delete.de: Right click twice: discard the stored structure.
infinity.extra.area_heist.too_big2: Too big (%s×%s×%s): at most %s per side
infinity.extra.area_heist.c2.select_a: Left: mark corner 1 · Right or Del: leave · middle: cancel
infinity.extra.area_heist.c2.select_b: Left: mark corner 2 · Right or Del: discard · middle: cancel
infinity.extra.area_heist.c2.select_go: Left: STEAL · Ctrl+scroll on a face: push or pull · Right or Del: discard
infinity.extra.area_heist.c2.place: Hold Alt for the tool bar and scroll to choose (%s) · Ctrl+scroll applies · Right: use the tool · Del or middle: leave
infinity.extra.area_heist.c2.place_left: Pick a tool (Alt+scroll) and use the right button
infinity.extra.area_heist.c2.delete_conf: Right click again to DELETE the stored structure
